heading.en: Why are railway girders shaped like the letter I?
heading.kn: ರೈಲ್ವೆ ಗರ್ಡರ್‌ಗಳು I ಅಕ್ಷರದ ಆಕಾರದಲ್ಲಿ ಏಕಿವೆ?

hook.en: Look under a railway bridge: the steel beams are not solid blocks but I-shaped. Elasticity tells us why this saves steel and still keeps the bridge stiff.
hook.kn: ರೈಲ್ವೆ ಸೇತುವೆಯ ಕೆಳಗೆ ನೋಡಿ: ಉಕ್ಕಿನ ತೊಲೆಗಳು I ಆಕಾರದಲ್ಲಿವೆ. ಇದು ಉಕ್ಕನ್ನು ಉಳಿಸಿ ಸೇತುವೆಯನ್ನು ಗಟ್ಟಿಯಾಗಿ ಇಡುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ಸ್ಥಿತಿಸ್ಥಾಪಕತ್ವ ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ.

objectives.en: Design a crane rope using the yield strength
Explain the bending of a beam and the I-shaped girder

narration.en: Look under a railway bridge: the steel beams are not solid blocks but I-shaped. Elasticity tells us why this saves steel and still keeps the bridge stiff.
narration.kn: ರೈಲ್ವೆ ಸೇತುವೆಯ ಕೆಳಗೆ ನೋಡಿ: ಉಕ್ಕಿನ ತೊಲೆಗಳು I ಆಕಾರದಲ್ಲಿವೆ. ಇದು ಉಕ್ಕನ್ನು ಉಳಿಸಿ ಸೇತುವೆಯನ್ನು ಗಟ್ಟಿಯಾಗಿ ಇಡುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ಸ್ಥಿತಿಸ್ಥಾಪಕತ್ವ ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: A rope must hold the load without its stress crossing the yield strength. The minimum area is A = W/σ_y. For a 10⁴ kg load and steel with σ_y = 3 × 10⁸ Pa, A ≈ 3.3 × 10⁻⁴ m², a radius of about 1 cm. Engineers add a factor of safety of about 10, so the radius becomes about 3 cm. The rope is made of many thin wires twisted together, which makes it flexible and strong.
body.kn: ಹಗ್ಗದ ಪ್ರತಿಬಲವು ಇಳುವರಿ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯವನ್ನು ಮೀರಬಾರದು. ಕನಿಷ್ಠ ವಿಸ್ತೀರ್ಣ A = W/σ_y. ಸುರಕ್ಷತಾ ಅಂಶ ಸುಮಾರು 10 ಸೇರಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ. ಹಗ್ಗವನ್ನು ಅನೇಕ ತೆಳು ತಂತಿಗಳಿಂದ ಹೆಣೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ.

say.en: A crane lifts ten tonnes with a steel rope. The stress in the rope must stay below the yield strength.
A beam of length l rests on two supports with a load W at its middle. It sags by δ.
The sag is W l cubed over 4 b d cubed Y. It falls as the cube of the depth d, so doubling the depth cuts the sag eight times.
A very deep, thin beam may buckle, so steel girders use an I-section: deep, but light.
Rock at a mountain's base must not flow. With yield stress 3 times ten to the 8 pascal and density 3000, the height is at most about 10 kilometres.

narration.en: A crane lifts ten tonnes with a steel rope. The stress in the rope must stay below the yield strength. A beam of length l rests on two supports with a load W at its middle. It sags by δ. The sag is W l cubed over 4 b d cubed Y. It falls as the cube of the depth d, so doubling the depth cuts the sag eight times. A very deep, thin beam may buckle, so steel girders use an I-section: deep, but light. Rock at a mountain's base must not flow. With yield stress 3 times ten to the 8 pascal and density 3000, the height is at most about 10 kilometres.

body.en: A beam of length l, breadth b and depth d loaded at the middle with W sags by δ = Wl³/(4bd³Y). Because δ ∝ 1/d³, increasing the depth is the best way to cut the sag. A deep beam may buckle, so an I-shaped section is used: a large depth with little material, and so less weight. The same ideas explain why mountains on Earth cannot be much higher than about 10 km.
body.kn: ಮಧ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರ W ಇರುವ ತೊಲೆಯ ಬಾಗುವಿಕೆ δ = Wl³/(4bd³Y). δ ∝ 1/d³ ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಆಳ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿಸುವುದು ಉತ್ತಮ. I ಆಕಾರ ಕಡಿಮೆ ವಸ್ತುವಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಆಳ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: I-section: large depth, little material, less buckling

problem.en: A crane must lift 10⁴ kg. The yield strength of steel is 3 × 10⁸ Pa. Find the minimum radius of the rope, and the radius with a factor of safety of 10. (g = 9.8 m s⁻²)

steps.en: With a factor of 10 the area is 10 times larger, so r grows by √10: r ≈ 3.2 cm.

answer.en: About 1 cm; about 3 cm with a safety factor of 10

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A crane must lift 10⁴ kg. The yield strength of steel is 3 × 10⁸ Pa. Find the minimum radius of the rope, and the radius with a factor of safety of 10. (g = 9.8 m s⁻²)

body.en: Sag δ ∝ 1/(b d³). Doubling the breadth halves the sag, but doubling the depth cuts it 8 times. That is why beams are laid on their narrow edge.

narration.en: Depth beats breadth. Sag δ ∝ 1/(b d³). Doubling the breadth halves the sag, but doubling the depth cuts it 8 times. That is why beams are laid on their narrow edge.
